title: A11y Type: --force Bypasses Disabled Gate; hwnd: Skips Scope Guard
desc: When hwnd: is in the grap, CheckMissingScope is skipped. When --force is passed, ReadinessContext.Force=true bypasses IsEnabled/IsVisible/ReadOnly gates in ActionReadiness for both Win32 and CDP paths.
steps: hwnd: in grap (e.g. {proc:'app',hwnd:0x1234}) bypasses CheckMissingScope. Regex 'hwnd\s*[:=]\s*0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+' early-returns the scope guard. This allows direct WM_CHAR injection to a specific hwnd without needing a #scope ancestor.

--force flag sets ReadinessContext.Force=true. In ActionReadiness.cs (Win32) and CdpActionReadiness.cs (CDP), the IsEnabled/IsVisible/ReadOnly blocking checks are wrapped with '!ctx.Force'. The warning message hints '--force to override' when the element is disabled.
Use case: HTS/Heroes4 controls that report IsEnabled=False but accept WM_CHAR input. Use: 'wkappbot --sudo a11y type {proc:"nfrunlite",hwnd:0xABCD} text --force'. Both guards are now bypassed.

Elevated #32770 PIN Edit fix (2026-05-01): 3 root causes resolved -- (1) IsAncestorWindow in A11yCommand+ActionReadiness prevents parent-window-as-blocker abort; (2) SetFocus(pinEditHwnd) targets specific Edit control before SendKeys; (3) VerifyEditCharsEntered via WM_GETTEXTLENGTH confirms chars landed + pre-clears before retry. Use --sudo for elevated dialogs.
